questions.evidence: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking, and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you

questions.q: Whom does Paul tell the older women to teach?
questions.evidence: that they may train the young women to love their husbands, to love their children

questions.q: According to what did God save us, Titus 3 says?
questions.evidence: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit
